dominant_strengths: Signature red gradient streaks against deep black create a strong, ownable visceral hero with high brand recall.
Floating pill nav with proper optical spacing and a clear primary Download CTA reads as confidently macOS-native.
Tight type hierarchy: oversized headline, calm subhead, and unobtrusive version metadata anchoring the bottom.
dominant_weaknesses: Headline sits directly atop the brightest gradient, reducing legibility and forcing the eye to fight figure-ground noise.
Vast vertical whitespace between subhead and download buttons leaves the composition bottom-heavy and unfocused.
Concept is conventional for launcher marketing — gradient + bold claim — innovation and system-level storytelling are thin.
fix_priorities: Shift gradient focal point off-center or darken behind the headline to restore contrast and hierarchy.
Tighten the gap between hero copy and CTAs, or introduce a product screenshot/Raycast UI peek to reward scroll.
Add a more distinctive secondary motif (command palette, keystroke vignette) to elevate distinctiveness beyond a gradient.
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral pull from the gradient, adequate behavioral clarity via nav and dual CTAs, but reflective payoff is limited because nothing demonstrates the product itself.
rationale.intent_fit: It clearly communicates Raycast as a premium Mac launcher, but leans on brand atmosphere over showing the actual shortcut-to-everything experience.
